title: request.rs JmapRequestBuilder::new: s.to_string() on &&str — use s.to_owned()
description: request.rs line 44: using.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect() — s is &&str here because iter() borrows the &[&str] slice. The idiomatic form is using.iter().map(|&s| s.to_owned()).collect() or using.iter().copied().map(str::to_owned).collect(). Calling .to_string() on &&str is non-idiomatic and dispatches through Display unnecessarily.
